text.p: Seagate Technology Inc said Wednesday it had signed cross-licensing agreements with Fujitsu Ltd and Micropolis (S) Pte Ltd covering certain existing and future patents.

The Micropolis agreement involves information-handling systems primarily designed to compute, classify or process any form of information or intelligence for business, scientific or other purposes; and manufacturing equipment related to the fabrication of these systems.

The agreement with Fujitsu covers magnetic hard disk drives, including fixed-disk and cartridge-type drives, magnetic hard-disk drive subsystems, and magnetic tape drives, and the components related to these products.
Seagate is a data technology company.
Fujitsu is the world's second largest computer manufacturer and a leader in telecommunications, semiconductors and other electronic devices.
Micropolis is a designer and manufacturer of high-performance disk drives.
